description: U. Michigan–Ann Arbor — strong MI in-state applicant, RD (residency-neutral sentinel)
rationale: THE KEY GUARD against a flat in-state boost returning. UMich publishes no residency split; the circulating '39% in-state' is mathematically impossible vs the official 17.9% overall, and our DB shows OOS 18% > overall 15.6% — i.e. OOS is admitted EASIER, so in-state earns NO boost (geo treated as neutral). A strong in-stater lands near the overall band (~0.17). Range [0.10, 0.25] brackets that; crucially the upper bound 0.25 would CATCH a regression to the old flat 1.8 (which would push this to 0.156×1.8 ≈ 0.28).
